data.case_title: Accident recognition (Arbeitsunfall) for Paul's school-cycling accident
data.explanation: This is good news: the statutory accident insurer has recognized your son Paul's bike accident on his way to school as a covered work accident (Arbeitsunfall). This means it will pay the doctors and physiotherapists directly for his treatment - you don't need to send in any receipts yourself. The letter also explains that you have the right to formally object (Widerspruch) if you disagree with any part of the decision; you can decide whether to use that right, and the app shows until when. If you do nothing, the decision as issued simply stands. Keep the file number (Aktenzeichen) in case you need to contact the insurer again.

items.title: Possible objection (Widerspruch) to the accident recognition decision
items.action: Decide whether you want to formally object (Widerspruch) to this decision in writing or in person at the Unfallkasse, even though it recognizes the accident in your favor
items.consequence: If the deadline shown passes without an objection, the decision becomes final
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.

items.title: Do not submit medical bills yourself
items.action: Let the treating doctors and physiotherapists send their invoices directly to the Unfallkasse instead of paying them yourself
items.quote: Rechnungen schicken die Praxen direkt an uns; bitte reichen Sie selbst keine Belege ein.

key_facts.label: Accident date
key_facts.quote: den Unfall Ihres Sohnes Paul am 14.09.2026 erkennen wir als Arbeitsunfall an.

key_facts.label: Legal basis for coverage of school ways
key_facts.quote: Schulwege sind nach § 8 Abs. 2 SGB VII versichert.

key_facts.label: Deemed delivery rule (Bekanntgabe)
key_facts.quote: Schicken wir Ihnen den Bescheid mit der Post, ist er am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden bekannt gegeben (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X).
